title: Blind Discovery: Chicane Obstacle Traversal
goal_description: Discover control parameters enabling smooth traversal through chicane obstacles without timeout or collision.

hypotheses.title: Increasing Tangential Gain for Improved Maneuverability
hypotheses.statement: Increasing the tangential gain will allow the robot to more precisely follow the path through the chicane obstacles.
hypotheses.mechanism: The tangential gain affects the robot's ability to turn and follow the path accurately.

hypotheses.title: Reducing Safety Margin for Increased Speed
hypotheses.statement: Reducing the safety margin will allow the robot to travel faster, potentially reducing the time to traverse the chicane.
hypotheses.mechanism: The safety margin controls how close the robot can get to obstacles while still considering the path safe.

titles: Increasing Tangential Gain for Improved Maneuverability
